title: kit.claude-policy.v1
description: claude.policy.json: the token-cost standard for Claude Code (docs/COST.md). Two files have this shape. The kit's defaults (packages/core/registry/claude.policy.json) are complete and have no `extends`. A project's own claude.policy.json (repository root, optional) has `extends: "kit"` and states only the values it overrides, always within the bounds written here (a ceiling a default may be tightened to, never lifted over). `kit claude sync` generates .claude/settings.json (cost keys) and the standard agents from the merged result; `kit check claude` (inside kit check canon) fails on drift. Raise a limit for one task with a CLI flag or /model, never by editing a default. The Claude Code facts behind each key are listed in docs/COST.md.

$schema.description: The $id of this schema (or a path to it).

extends.description: Present in a project's override file: every value not stated comes from the kit's defaults. Absent in the kit's own defaults, which must be complete.

model.description: settings.json `model`: the main session's default. Opus is chosen for one task with `claude --model opus` or /model; switching mid-session breaks the prompt cache (docs: prompt-caching).

effort.description: settings.json `effortLevel`: the default effort. xhigh and max are raised per task (`claude --effort xhigh`); in project settings the key applies to every model.

maxLines.description: Longest allowed CLAUDE.md, in lines. Longer files consume more context every session; move reference material into path-scoped rules or skills. 200 is the docs' ceiling and cannot be raised.

model.description: env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: the model of every subagent that no definition or Agent call assigns one.

searchModel.description: The model of search and exploration agents (agent `model: search`).

maxConcurrent.description: env CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS (Claude Code's own default is 20).

promptCacheTtl.description: env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL: 1-hour cache writes are billed higher; short-lived subagents rarely reuse them.

maxTurnsCeiling.description: No project agent may declare a larger maxTurns. Every project agent must declare `model` and `maxTurns` (not configurable).

allowedModels.description: Models a project agent's `model` may name. Adding opus is a reviewed decision of the project; the default list excludes it.

standard.description: The standard agents `kit claude sync` writes to .claude/agents/<name>.md, by name. A project may override single fields of one, or add its own (all required fields then).

loops.description: Budgets of every scripted agent loop (a "ralph" loop: a script that runs `claude -p` repeatedly).

maxIterations.description: Most iterations a loop may declare.

wallClockMinutes.description: Longest wall-clock time a loop may declare.

paths.description: Directories or globs scanned for loop scripts.

managed.description: Owner-only: what the claude.ai admin console holds (no repository can set it). Kit defaults only; a project cannot override it.

maxEffortLevel.description: Managed `maxEffortLevel`: the organisation-wide cap (`max` sets no cap, so it is never listed).

spendLimitsUsd.description: Proposed monthly spend limits, set by hand in the admin console and the Console workspace (no JSON exists for them); the owner confirms the numbers.

agentEffort.description: Effort levels an agent's frontmatter `effort` may carry (what the Claude Code docs allow; the settings default `effort` is bounded lower). `kit check claude` reads this list.

description.description: When Claude should delegate to it (kept short: all descriptions load every session).

model.description: A role, resolved from subagents.searchModel or subagents.model.

tools.description: Allowed tools; omitted = every tool a subagent has.

omitClaudeMd.description: Launch without the CLAUDE.md files (agents that take all they need from the delegation prompt).

prompt.description: The agent's system prompt (the file body).

complete.description: The merged policy: every value present, every agent whole.
